## Which one

Pick by platform; within a platform there is no single right answer:

- **Android**: start with NekoInverter (conservative) or SXJ (Chinese-oriented); try MD3 forks if you want the newer UI
- **iOS**: EhPanda
- **Desktop / cross-platform**: JHenTai

Back up your favorites and history before switching — data formats differ between forks.
